girdi.command: grep -n "testHaiku" -A 60 test/all.js | head -90; echo "---PKG---"; cat package.json

python - <<'EOF'
import io
p='test/all.js'
s=io.open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
old="  ok('sonnet passes', call('sonnet') === null);\n"
new=old+"  ok('opus passes', call('opus') === null);\n"
assert s.count(old)==1
io.open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8',newline='').write(s.replace(old,new))
EOF
sed -n 1618,1626p test/all.js; ls test/
